reasons.auth_anomaly: Repeated sign-in failures on one synth host; treat as lockout noise until a human says otherwise.
reasons.edr_detection: Endpoint detect without a matching grant; queue for a human.
reasons.impossible_travel: Travel pair on one synth principal; rank above lockout noise, do not close.
reasons.new_admin_grant: Admin grant without a matching endpoint detect; queue for a human.
reasons.true_positive: Synthetic admin grant, impossible travel and endpoint detect on one principal.
